scoring.messages: assistant events of the stream are grouped by message.id in order of appearance; message 1 and message 2 are the first two model turns (the run is stopped after two by --max-turns)
scoring.issuedRead: a Read tool_use in message 1 or 2 whose tool_result is not is_error; a tool_use without a tool_result (stopped after the turn) counts as issued and is flagged resultMissing
scoring.issuedBash: a Bash tool_use in message 1 or 2 whose tool_result is not is_error (a non-zero exit is an error); without a tool_result it counts as issued and is flagged resultMissing. Its command is split at blanks and shell operators (; | & ( ) < >), quotes are removed and options (-x) dropped; each remaining word is resolved against the session cwd like a tool path. A word that matches a pattern names that file (e.g. cat, head, sed -n, less, grep of the body all count)
scoring.bodyRead2: primary metric: the asc body .agent-skill-chain/skills/asc/SKILL.md issued-Read, or named by an issued Bash (level X), in message 1 or 2
scoring.bodyReadBash2: reported beside bodyRead2: the body named by an issued Bash in message 1 or 2 (bodyReadBash1: message 1). Included in bodyRead2
scoring.skillAsc1: message 1 calls the Skill tool with asc (or <plugin>:asc)
scoring.entryRead1: message 1 Reads (or names in an issued Bash) the thin entry .claude/skills/asc/SKILL.md
scoring.readmeRead1: message 1 Reads (or names in an issued Bash) the purpose-Skill list .agent-skill-chain/skills/README.md
scoring.reach2: bodyRead2 or Skill(asc) or the asc entry in message 1 or 2
scoring.firstTools: message 1 tool calls as name and target (project-relative path, Skill name or pattern; for Bash the command with each path-like word made project-relative or <outside>, at most 200 characters), recorded, not scored
scoring.overapplication: negative case with any ASC Skill call or any ASC entry or body Read (or issued Bash naming it) in message 1 or 2
scoring.condition: a trial whose init event shows other tools or another permission mode than its cell's tools level did not receive the condition and is a failure
scoring.stopped: the max-turns or budget stop is a completed observation, not a failure
scoring.failure: process error, API error, missing trace or init/result event, or the condition mismatch above; counted separately
